clue.text: Edge in a number entering city vice

indicators.note: entering means the group of pieces before it goes inside the word for city

parts.note: taken as written
a rim is an edge
taken as written
L is the Roman numeral for fifty, a number

explanation.surface: A man with an edge on others muscles into the vice trade of a big town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' looks like a criminal breaking in, but it is the container signal; L as fifty is a Roman numeral convention.
explanation.definitionFit: Vice in the sense of wrongdoing or lawbreaking as a whole is criminal behaviour.

clue.text: What a calculating dentist may extract

definitions.text: What a calculating dentist may extract

parts.words: What a calculating dentist may extract
parts.note: a dentist pulls out the base part of a tooth, while a mathematician extracts the square kind

explanation.surface: A dentist who is good at sums is about to pull something out.
explanation.definitionFit: Mathematicians extract a square one from a number, and a tooth's anchoring part is pulled by dentists.

clue.text: Sea food making for sound muscles

indicators.note: sound tells us the following word is said aloud and a different spelling is entered

parts.note: the body's muscles, which is how the entered word is pronounced

explanation.surface: Eating seafood is a way of building up healthy muscles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' here looks like 'healthy', but it signals a homophone.
explanation.definitionFit: These shellfish are bivalves served as seafood, often steamed in wine.

clue.text: Great river with nothing to the east

parts.note: nil means nothing, zero

explanation.surface: A great river has no land at all to its east.
explanation.definitionFit: Africa's longest waterway, flowing north through Egypt, is a great river.

clue.text: Its reel becomes tangled in the hand of salmon catcher

indicators.note: a tangled line is twisted out of order, so the letters of the words before are rearranged

explanation.surface: An angler's reel line gets snarled while he fights a salmon in his hand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'becomes tangled' rearranges ITS REEL. A leister is a pronged spear used for catching fish, especially salmon.
explanation.definitionFit: A pronged fishing spear, traditionally used by poachers and Scottish fishermen to take salmon.

clue.text: What tourists should take before fall

definitions.meaning: tourists take a journey or excursion
to stumble and fall over something

explanation.definitionFit: A holiday tourists take is an outing, and a stumble that brings someone down is also this word.

clue.text: Stand for suggestion that old ill uminators go like clockwork

definitions.meaning: a holder that something stands in

definitions.text: suggestion that old ill uminators go like clockwork
definitions.meaning: old lights are wax candles, and to go like clockwork is to tick

explanation.walkthrough: The page splits 'illuminators' across a line; the second reading splits the answer into CANDLES TICK.
explanation.definitionFit: A holder for wax lights is a stand, and old lamps that tick like clocks give the split reading.

clue.text: Masses sick with it is possible cause of sore throat

parts.note: tons means masses, lots
ill means sick
taken as written

explanation.surface: Feeling poorly with lots of symptoms, someone suspects an inflamed throat.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflammation of the glands at the back of the mouth is a common source of throat pain.

clue.text: One who counts all holes except the nineteenth?

definitions.text: One who counts all holes except the nineteenth?

parts.words: One who counts all holes except the nineteenth?
parts.note: a golfer who adds up the tees on the course, but avoids the clubhouse bar, jokingly called the nineteenth hole

explanation.walkthrough: The nineteenth hole is golfing slang for the clubhouse bar; split the answer as TEE TOTALLER, one who totals tees.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who abstains from alcohol skips the bar, so a golfer counting only the eighteen holes fits.

clue.text: Another look at the power of prophecy

definitions.meaning: the gift of seeing the future

explanation.definitionFit: A further view is a repeat glimpse, and clairvoyance, foreseeing events, is the other sense.

clue.text: The central aim of those who want to bowl over

definitions.text: The central aim of those who want to bowl over

parts.words: The central aim of those who want to bowl over
parts.note: a cricket bowler trying to knock down the wicket aims at the centre one of its three upright sticks

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the wicket has three stumps; a bowler aims to knock over the one in the centre.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket bowler's target, the central upright of the three wooden stakes forming a wicket.

clue.text: Spirit delivered from endless peril

indicators.note: endless means the word loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A spirit rescues someone from mortal danger.
explanation.walkthrough: A peri is a fairy or spirit of Persian legend.
explanation.definitionFit: In Persian mythology a peri is a fairy-like supernatural being, a sprite.

clue.text: A listed assortment of particulars

indicators.note: an assortment is a mixed collection, so the letters of the words after are mixed up

explanation.surface: A catalogued selection of items is set out one by one.
explanation.definitionFit: Particulars are specific facts or items of information.

clue.text: Fish stand surfaces

definitions.meaning: flatfish such as the Dover variety
the undersides of the feet, what people stand on

explanation.definitionFit: Flatfish are one sense, and the bottoms of feet or shoes, the surfaces we stand on, the other.

clue.text: Ponders devious answer

indicators.note: devious means winding off the straight path, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone mulls over a crafty reply.
explanation.definitionFit: To answer is to reply or react to something said.

clue.text: Part of rare currency likely to turn up again

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A scarce coin is expected to show up once more.
explanation.definitionFit: To happen again or reappear repeatedly is the verb's sense.

clue.text: Newly ordered robes are not tight

indicators.note: put in a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Freshly bought gowns turn out to be loose fitting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tight' looks like a fit of clothes, but is slang for drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Tight is slang for drunk, so someone not drunk is clear-headed.

clue.text: Initially, the seven made up of 24

indicators.note: made up of says the letters of the referenced answer are rearranged

parts.note: the answer to 24 down, a word for chance or destiny

explanation.surface: From the start, the group of seven was formed from twenty-four.
explanation.walkthrough: The European Free Trade Association had seven founding members in 1960.
explanation.definitionFit: The European Free Trade Association began with seven member countries.

clue.text: Woodcutter adds sound effect

indicators.note: the phrase tells us a word is said aloud and spelt differently

parts.note: adds, sums up, pronounced the same as the entered tool

explanation.surface: A lumberjack puts in some noise for the film.
explanation.definitionFit: An adze is an axe-like tool with an arched blade, used for shaping timber.

clue.text: Heavenly body with the most heavenly body

definitions.meaning: a planet, the second from the sun
the Roman goddess of love and beauty, with a divinely beautiful figure

explanation.definitionFit: The bright planet is a celestial object, and the goddess of beauty has the loveliest figure.

clue.text: Bond drawer heartens Volunteer Reserve on a sliding scale

indicators.note: heartens is read as puts into the heart of, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: VR is the abbreviation for Volunteer Reserve
ERNIE is the machine that draws the winning British Premium Bond numbers

explanation.surface: A spy-story artist encourages the reservists over a pay scale.
explanation.walkthrough: Premium Bonds are a British government savings lottery whose winning numbers are picked by a machine; 'heartens' means goes into the heart of.
explanation.definitionFit: A small movable graduated scale for fine measurement, as on callipers.

clue.text: Expatriate who pays up

definitions.meaning: someone who has gone to live in a new country
a person who clears a debt or bill

explanation.definitionFit: A colonist abroad is one sense, and one who clears an account is the other.

clue.text: Tickets for everyone in the draws

indicators.note: in places the word for everyone inside the word for draws

parts.note: ties are drawn games
all means everyone

explanation.surface: Each person in the raffle gets a ticket.
explanation.definitionFit: Tallies are tags or labels, ticket-like counters for keeping score or identifying items.

clue.text: Acknowledgment of an old recipe

definitions.meaning: a written note confirming payment or delivery
an archaic word for a cooking recipe

explanation.definitionFit: A slip confirming payment is one sense; in older English this word also meant a recipe.

clue.text: Sign on staff

parts.note: a symbol written on the five lines of a musical stave, not a notice for employees

explanation.walkthrough: 'staff' looks like employees but is the musical stave.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical symbol at the start of a stave that sets the pitch of the notes.

clue.text: Chance putting two notes together

parts.note: fa is a note of the sol-fa scale
te is another note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Luck brings two musical notes together.
explanation.definitionFit: Destiny or fortune, what chance brings.

clue.text: The burden carried by America apparently

parts.note: on, as when a weight rests on someone
US is the abbreviation for the United States of America

explanation.surface: The weight that the United States seems to shoulder.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'carried by America' as resting ON the US.
explanation.definitionFit: A responsibility or duty is a burden one must bear.

clue.text: A fashion line which causes embarrassed cough

parts.note: a hem is the line at the bottom of a skirt, which fashion raises and lowers

explanation.surface: A new style of skirt length makes someone clear their throat awkwardly.
explanation.definitionFit: The interjection used to clear one's throat to draw attention or show awkwardness.

clue.text: It starts where Australasia ends

indicators.note: ends picks out the closing run of letters of the place name

explanation.surface: A geography lesson: one continent begins exactly where its southern neighbour region finishes.
explanation.walkthrough: The continent begins where Australasia gives way to it, and its name is the last four letters of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest continent lies directly north of the Australasian region.

clue.text: Limit set by a slight inclination to be agnostic

parts.note: a ration is a limit on allowance
a list is a slight lean, as of a ship

explanation.surface: Someone sets a boundary on how far to lean towards religious doubt.
explanation.definitionFit: An agnostic relies on reason over faith, a thinker who wants evidence before belief.

clue.text: Rester disturbed by court case of world significance

indicators.note: disturbed means stirred up, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a trial is a case in court

explanation.surface: Someone resting is woken by a legal case of global importance.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the Earth, hence of the world.
